description: The main window may read live and saved data, export or delete it after the user confirms in a native dialog, block after the user confirms in a native dialog, lift blocks, read and change the app's own settings (start at sign-in, notifications), read alerts, and mark them as fine (stopping warnings about a risky network is confirmed in a native dialog), switch list updates on or off, and switch saving history on or off (turning it off asks in a native dialog whether to keep or delete what is saved), read what was learned about an app, reset it after the user confirms in a native dialog, and say whether an app goes anywhere. No dialog, file system, shell or network permissions of its own.
